Show basic Brand tips on all Brand cards

Whether to show the basic Brand mechanic descriptions on the side of cards. Since these tooltips take up significant screen space, it is recommended to disable them once you are familiar with the mechanics.
HATMAGICIAN2-SHOW_FUSION_BRAND_COLOR_TIP: Show Blended Brand tips on starting relic
Whether to show Blended Brand tooltips on the starting relic. Since these tooltips take up significant screen space, it is recommended to disable them once you are familiar with them.
HATMAGICIAN2-CHALLENGE_COLOR_FINDER.titl: Allow Color Finder to appear as a Boss
HATMAGICIAN2-CHALLENGE_COLOR_FINDER.hove: When checked, the Color Finder has a chance to appear as the boss.
HATMAGICIAN2-SHOW_OTHERS_BRAND_PET.title: Teammate Color Display Player Cap
HATMAGICIAN2-SHOW_OTHERS_BRAND_PET.hover: Limits teammate Color display in multiplayer mode. Sets the maximum number of players whose Colors will be displayed (you will always occupy 1 display slot, whether you currently have Colors or not).
